# Load libraries

```{r}
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(vegan)
```

# Load data

Set paths to data directory and output directory
```{r}
data_path = "path/to/data"

output_path  = "path/to/save/outputs"
```

```{r}
esviritu_res <- fread(paste0(data_path, "Esviritu_HostDiseaseGenometypeV5.tsv"))

esviritu_res_human <- esviritu_res %>% 
  filter(host_species == "Homo sapiens")

sample_metadata <- read.csv(paste0(data_path, "samples_metadata.csv"), sep=";", dec=",")
```

## Function for RPKMF value calculation (at taxa level)

```{r}
RPKMF_df <- function(data, tax_level){
  RPKMF_df <- data %>%
    group_by(sample_id, !!sym(tax_level)) %>%
    summarize(RPKMF = sum(true_rpkmf)) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  RPKMF_df_wide <-pivot_wider(data=RPKMF_df,
                    names_from = sample_id,
                    values_from = RPKMF,
                    values_fill = list(RPKMF=0))

  return(RPKMF_df_wide)
}
```

## PERMANOVA on Bray-Curtis distance

```{r}
species_df <- RPKMF_df(esviritu_res_human, "species")

bray_curtis_human <- vegdist(t(species_df[,-1]), method="bray")
```

## Test the significance of YEAR - whole dataset
```{r}
set.seed(2025)
permanova_bc_human_year <- adonis2(bray_curtis_human ~ Year_cat, 
                                   data=sample_metadata,
                                   permutations=999, by="margin")

permanova_bc_human_year 
```

## Test the significance of CITY - whole dataset

```{r}
set.seed(2025)
permanova_bc_human <- adonis2(bray_curtis_human ~ City, 
                              data=sample_metadata,
                              permutations=999, by="margin")
permanova_bc_human
```

## Test the significance of CITY - within each year

```{r}
bc_20_21_human <- as.data.frame(as.matrix(bray_curtis_human))[1:60,1:60]

bc_24_25_human <- as.data.frame(as.matrix(bray_curtis_human))[61:120, 61:120]
```

```{r}
set.seed(2025)
permanova_bc_human_20_21 <- adonis2(bc_20_21_human ~ City, 
                                    data=sample_metadata[1:60,],
                                    permutations=999, by="margin")
permanova_bc_human_20_21
```

```{r}
permanova_bc_human_24_25 <- adonis2(bc_24_25_human ~ City, 
                                    data=sample_metadata[61:120,],
                                    permutations=999, by="margin")
permanova_bc_human_24_25
```

## PCoA plot on Bray-Curtis distance

```{r PCoA-Bray-Curtis}
set.seed(2025)

plot_PCoA <- function(data, taxa_level, annot_col, annot_shape){

  #calculate RPKMF df (cols species, rows samples)
  RPKMF_df <- RPKMF_df(data, taxa_level)
  
  bray_curtis <- as.data.frame(as.matrix(vegdist(t(RPKMF_df[,-1]))), method="bray")
  
  bray_curtis$sample_ID1 <- rownames(bray_curtis)

  
  pcoa <- cmdscale(bray_curtis[,-ncol(bray_curtis)], eig=TRUE)
  pcoa_df <- as.data.frame(pcoa$points)
  pcoa_df$sample_id <- bray_curtis$sample_ID1

  pcoa_df_meta <- merge(pcoa_df, sample_metadata, by.x="sample_id", by.y="sample_ID")
  
  #explained variance by PC 
  exp_var <- pcoa$eig /(sum(pcoa$eig))
  PC1_var <- round(exp_var[1]*100, 2)
  PC2_var <- round(exp_var[2]*100, 2)

  
  plot <- ggplot(pcoa_df_meta, 
                 aes(x = V1, y = V2, 
                     color=.data[[annot_col]],
                     shape=.data[[annot_shape]])) +
  geom_point(size=4) +
    
  labs(x=sprintf("PCoA-1 (%s %%)", PC1_var), 
       y= sprintf("PCoA-2 (%s %%)", PC2_var)) +
    
  scale_color_manual(values= pal <- c("#7B71B6","#E06666"),
                     name="Year") +
  scale_shape_manual(values=c(17, 16, 15, 18, 3), name="City") +
  theme_bw()

}

```

```{r}
beta_PCoA_human_season_year <- plot_PCoA(data=esviritu_res_human, 
                                         taxa_level="species", 
                                         annot_col = "Year_cat", 
                                         annot_shape = "City") +
  theme(legend.position="bottom", 
        legend.box="vertical", 
        legend.margin=margin(),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 14),
        legend.text = element_text(size=14))

beta_PCoA_human_season_year

ggsave(beta_PCoA_human_season_year, 
       file = paste0(output_path, "beta_PCoA_human_season_year.jpg"), 
       width = 7.2, height = 5, units = "in", dpi=300)
```
